summary: East kerb near the crest of a residential street; homes 21-25 m away.
reasons: Homes 21-25 m away on this side

best_section.where: East kerb of Newcomen Street just below the crest, before the top bend

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings at 21 m (at 85 m), 25 m (at 93 m) and 23 m (at 107 m) on the section's own side; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along the kerbs in the imagery, so a van can pull in clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Local residential traffic; motorway noise from the west.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb here, so a van is not out of place; no signs.

sun_shade: Mixed tree canopy; partial shade, mostly from the east side gardens.
